counting_rule: Count each real tactical CLI process and each fixed full-stage simulation at STARTED, including failures and timeouts. Iterate at most three independent loops; stop immediately on an 8-ID WIN. No automatic retry, resume, replacement call, balance transfer, or budget v2/v3 expansion. Pre-STARTED gate rejections do not count.
non_stackable: All historical/frozen balances do not transfer; M67's unused simulation does not transfer. M52 V1 nine-operator WIN remains the frozen baseline until an M68 8-ID WIN is verified.
